```{r setup-2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
source("../../Modell/!afs_biomass_setup.r")
source("../../Modell/extract_result.R")
source("../../Modell/!helper_func.r")
source("../../Modell/!helper_instance_builder_v8a.R")
source("../../Modell/!build_AFS_milp.r")
#Rcpp::sourceCpp("../../Modell/build_and_solve_afs_lp_v11.cpp")

#load("../Modell/afs_workspace.RData")
load("../../Paper/afs_workspace_red.RData")


sites_sf   <- afs_workspace$sites_sf
sites      <- afs_workspace$sites
sites_clustered      <- afs_workspace$sites_clustered
storages   <- afs_workspace$storages
consumers  <- afs_workspace$consumers

# scale down industrial demand quantities by dividing by 5
consumers <- consumers %>%
  mutate(demand_P1 = demand_P1 / 5)

# drop small Biogas plants --> compute total demand and drop all consumer with D<2
consumers <- consumers %>%
  mutate(total_demand = demand_P1 + demand_P2 + demand_P3) %>%
  filter(total_demand >= 1.5) %>%
  select(-total_demand) 


dist_jk <- afs_workspace$dist_jk[,consumers$consumer_id]

yields_by_age <- build_scenario_ts(ages = 1:20 , N = 250, C_site = 6.500, k = 0.194, t0 = 9.7, label = "Conservative (250 trees/ha)")


yields_by_age <- yields_by_age %>% 
  # drop column scenario from yields_by_age
  select(-scenario) %>% 
  # make long --> bring columns Merch. stem Merch. branch Residue to column "product" and values to "yield_ha"
  pivot_longer(-1 , names_to = "product", values_to = "yield_ha") %>% 
  # rename entries in "product" to 1:3
  mutate(product = as.integer(as.character(factor(product, labels = c(2,1,3) ))))

# scale yields to fresh biomass
yields_by_age$yield_ha <- yields_by_age$yield_ha / (1-0.5)


set.seed(123578)
# generate random vector of opportunity cost for clustered sites in range [0,600]
c.opp.vec <- rnorm(nrow(sites_clustered), 1, .75)


sites_clustered <- sites_clustered %>%
   mutate(
     C_est  = 2500,   # €/ha  establishment (Section 2.1 mid-range)
     C_harv =  150,    # €/ha  harvest cost  (Section 2.1 mid-range)
     C_main = 10 , #  €/ha  maintenance cost  (Section 2.1 mid-range)
     C_opp = 150*c.opp.vec, #  €/ha  opportunity cost  (Section 2.1 mid-range)
   ) #%>%   # change column name area_ha to area if necessary  rename(area_ha = area)


# # change storage costs
# storages$c_stor <- storages$c_stor
# # change capacities
 storages$CAP_stor <- storages$CAP_stor * 100000
 storages$CAP_proc <- storages$CAP_proc * 100000
# 
data_obj <- list(
   sites    = sites_clustered,
  #sites    = sites_filt,
   storages = storages,
   consumers = consumers,
   dist_ij  = afs_workspace$dist_ij_clust,
   #dist_ij  = dist_ij_filt$distance_matrix_km,
   dist_jk  = dist_jk,
   yields_by_age = yields_by_age
 )
# rescale demands in consumers to tons
data_obj$consumers[,c("demand_P1","demand_P2","demand_P3")]  <- data_obj$consumers[,c("demand_P1","demand_P2","demand_P3")] * 1000

# 
# # ── 3. PARAMS OBJECT — all scalar parameters ──────────────────────────────────
params_obj <- list(
   n_periods  = 40,
   max_age    = 15L,    # A_max: LRAFS upper rotation bound
   min_age    =  3L,    # A_min: SRAFS lower rotation bound
   c_tr_raw   = 0.08,   # €/(t·km)  raw biomass  site → storage
   c_tr_pre   = 0.06   # €/(t·km)  chips        storage → consumer
 )
# 
# ── 4. generate instance ─────────────────────────────────────
milp_instance <- build_optimization_instance(
    data         = data_obj,
    params       = params_obj
  ) 

# result <- build_and_solve_afs_lp_v11(milp_instance,

# 
#saveRDS(result, "result_lp_v11.rds")

result <- readRDS("../../Paper/result_lp_v11.rds")

ext <- result$solution_vector

#  renaming

ext$Xjk <- ext$Xjk %>% 
  rename(src_product = p, del_product = q, period = t, hub_id = j, consumer_id = k)

ext$Xij <- ext$Xij %>% 
  rename(period = t, site_id = i, hub_id = j)

ext$z <- ext$z %>% 
  rename(arc_type = type, site_id = i )

ext$S <- ext$S %>% 
  rename(hub_id = j, period = t)

# load scenario results 
res.sens.list <- readRDS("../../Paper/res_sens_list_lp_v11.rds")

## Economics of Agrofoerstry systems


.col-40[
```{r afs-tree-interactive, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
 library("collapsibleTree")


# ── Data structure: parent-child relationships ──────────────────
economics <- data.frame(
  Level1 = c(
    # Costs
    rep("Costs", 5),
    # Returns
    rep("Returns", 4)
  ),

  Level2 = c(
    # Costs → leaf nodes (5)
    "Estabishment costs",
    "Maintenance costs",
    "Harvest costs (Arable Crops)",
    "Harvest costs (Timber & Fruits)",
    "Opportunity costs (land foregone)",
    # Returns → leaf nodes (6)
    "Wood & Fruits",
    "Arable Crop Yield",
    "Agricultural Subsidies\n& Direct Payments",
    "Carbon Credits\n& C-Markets"
  )
)

# ── Colour vector: exactly 1 + 3 + 19 = 23 values ──────────────
fill_colours <- c(
  # Root (1)
  "#2d6a2d", 
  # Level 2 (3): Costs | Returns | Risk & Time
  "#c0392b", "#27ae60",
  # Level 3 – Costs (8)
  rep("#f1948a", 5),
  # Level 3 – Returns (7)
  rep("#a9dfbf", 4)
)

# Sanity check (remove after verification)
# message("Number of fill values: ", length(fill_colours))  # must be 23

# ── Diagram ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
collapsibleTree(
  economics,
  hierarchy  = c("Level1", "Level2"),
  width      = 400,
  height     = 400,
  fontSize   = 18,
  nodeSize   = "leafCount",
  fill       = fill_colours,
  tooltip    = TRUE,
  collapsed  = FALSE
)
```
]

.col-60[
<!-- small text -->
.small[
- **Costs:** 
  - Establishment: site preparation, planting, ...
  - maintenance: pruning, pest management, ...
  - harvest: increased crop & additional tree harvesting cost
  - opportunity: foregone crop revenues for land with AFS 
- **Returns:** 
  - Wood & fruits: timber (only once), fruits (like nuts, annual)
  - crop yield: potential increase due to improved microclimate, ...
  - subsidies: agricultural subsidies, direct payments, ...
  - carbon credits: potential sequestration revenue from carbon markets, ...
]

.callout-block[ 
  .small[
    Which effects dominates, depends on cost and revenue drivers. 
    ]
  ]
]

## Agroforestry system types & design parameters

.col-40[
**Short Rotation Coppice (SRC)**
.center[
<img src="https://pplx-res.cloudinary.com/image/upload/pplx_search_images/b85e327b53548ec58761b530c078ce006f4f6a56.jpg" style="width:55%; margin-bottom:8px;">
]

**Agroforestry System (AFS)**
.center[
<img src="https://pplx-res.cloudinary.com/image/upload/pplx_search_images/1bef14d477d7b6bcc161e077fa6758919766f1a2.jpg" style="width:55%; margin-bottom:8px;">
]
]

.col-60[
.small[
- **Tree species choice**  (e.g. `r Citep(bib, "Huber2018_SRAFS_growth")`)
  Suitability to climate and soils, target products (timber and/or fruits), 

- **Spacing**  (e.g. `r Citep(bib, "Testa2014_Poplar_Economics")`)
  Distance between tree rows and trees; determines growth, access for machinery, ...

- **Row orientation**  
  Alignment with respect to sun and prevailing winds $\rightarrow$ erosion protection 

- **Tree–crop distance**  
  Lateral distance from crop strips to tree rows; moderates below‑ and above‑ground competition

- **Rotation length**  (e.g. `r Citep(bib, "Niemczyk2021_Poplar_Rotation")`)
  Duration until harvest (short vs. long rotation), determines growth & revenue cycles
]
]

---

## Modelling Biomass Growth


.col-40[
.small[
- multiple models available $\rightarrow$ here 3-parameter Gompertz model chosen
 $$B(t) = a \cdot \exp\!\bigl(-\exp(-k \cdot (t - t_0))\bigr)$$
- $B(t)$ biomass quantity (in tons per ha) after $t$ years of growth
- parameters: 
  - $a$...asymptotic biomass quantity
  - $k$...growth rate
  - $t_0$...inflection time (max. growth rate)
- parameter values highly dependent on tree species, local climate, planting details, ... `r Citep(bib, "Jha2018_Poplar_AFS_Biomass")`
]
]

.col-60[
```{r max3-growth, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=6, out.width="90%", cache=TRUE}
# Code-Chunk direkt aus paper.Rmd (Abschnitt max3-growth)

age.vec <- seq(0, 20, by = 0.1)

cons <- build_scenario_ts(ages = age.vec , N = 300, C_site = 6.500, k = 0.194, t0 = 9.7, label = "Conservative (250 trees/ha)")

comp_long <- bind_rows(cons) |>
  rename(stem = "Merch. stem", branch = "Merch. branch", residue = Residue) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c("stem", "branch", "residue"),
               names_to = "component", values_to = "biomass") |>
  mutate(
    component = factor(component,
      levels = c("residue", "branch", "stem")),
    scenario  = factor(scenario,
      levels = c("Conservative (113 trees/ha)", "Good site (139 trees/ha)"))
  ) %>% 
  select(-scenario)

# totals_long <- comp_long |>
#   group_by(age, scenario) |>
#   summarise(total = sum(biomass), .groups = "drop")

emp_pts <- tribble(
  ~age, ~AGB,   ~p_stem, ~p_branch,
   8,   134.3,  0.747,   0.166, # N = 400
   9,    74.0,  0.830,   0.110, # N = 500
   9,    51.5,  0.920,   0.040, # N = 500
  10,   119,    0.76,   0.210,# N = 139
  13,   152.0,  0.770,   0.220 # N = 139
) |>
  mutate(stem_cum   = AGB * p_stem,
         branch_cum = AGB * (p_stem + p_branch),
         total      = AGB)

emp_long <- bind_rows(
  emp_pts |> transmute(age, biomass = stem_cum,   series = "Empirical: stem"),
  emp_pts |> transmute(age, biomass = branch_cum, series = "Empirical: stem+branches"),
  emp_pts |> transmute(age, biomass = total,      series = "Empirical: total biomass")
) |> mutate(series = factor(series, levels = c(
  "Empirical: stem", "Empirical: stem+branches", "Empirical: total biomass")))

emp_col   <- c("Empirical: stem"          = "darkgreen",
               "Empirical: stem+branches" = "darkorange",
               "Empirical: total biomass"     = "navy")
emp_shape <- c("Empirical: stem"          = 21L,
               "Empirical: stem+branches" = 24L,
               "Empirical: total biomass"     = 23L)

ggplot(comp_long, aes(x = age, y = biomass)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5, xmax = 15, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,

# Designing AFS Supply Chains

---

## Model description

.callout-block[
  Objective is to maximize the total profit of an AFS Supply Chain over a time horizon of $T$ years. The supply chain consists of a set of farms ($\mathcal{I}$, potential AFS sites), a set of wood logistics hubs ($\mathcal{J}$), and a set of industrial consumer $\mathcal{K}$. 
]

**Decisions:**
- Establishment: Is an AFS established on farm $i \in \mathcal{I}$?
- Harvest: In which period $t \in \mathcal{T}$ is an AFS on farm $i$ harvested?
- Processing: In which period $t$ and in which hub $j \in \mathcal{J}$ is harvested AFS biomass pretreated?
- Supply: In which period $t$ and consumer $k \in \mathcal{K}$ is AFS biomass usage?

---

## Modelling establishing & harvesting decisions 

For a time horizon of $T=8$ minium rotation length $A^{\min}=3$ and maximum rotation length $A^{\max}=5$

---

## Objective Function

.small[
$$
\begin{aligned}
\max\; Z \;=\;&
  \sum_{k ,\, p} R_{kp} \cdot\sum_{j,\,(p',p),\, t} x_{jkp'pt}  &\text{Revenue}  \label{eq:obj-revenue} \\
&- \sum_{i} c^{\text{est}}_i \cdot \text{AREA}_i  \cdot\sum_{(0,t) } z_{i0t} &\text{establishment cost}\\
&- \sum_{i} c^{\text{opp}}_i \cdot \text{AREA}_i \cdot\left(\sum_{(s,T+1) } (s+1) \cdot z_{is(T+1)}  -  \sum_{(0,t)}  t \cdot z_{i0t} \right) &\text{opportunity cost}\\
&- \sum_{i} c^{\text{main}}_{i} \cdot (t-s) \cdot \text{AREA}_i \sum_{(s,t) } z_{ist} &\text{maintenance cost}\\
&- \sum_{i} c^{\text{harv}}_i \cdot \text{AREA}_i \cdot \sum_{(s,t) } z_{ist} &\text{harvesting cost}\\
&- \sum_{i,\, j,\, p,\, t} c^{\text{tr-raw}}_p \cdot d_{ij} \cdot X_{ijpt} &\text{transport cost}\\
&- \sum_{j,\, k,\,(p,p'),\, t} c^{\text{tr-pre}}_{p'} \cdot d_{jk} \cdot X_{jkpp't} &\text{transport cost}\\
&- \sum_{j,\, p,\, t}  c^{\text{stor}}_j \cdot S_{jpt} &\text{storage cost}
\end{aligned}
$$
]

---

## Constraints (C1–C4)
.small[
**Single establishment per site:**
$$\sum_{(0,t)\in\mathcal{S}^{est}} z_{i0t} \leq 1 \qquad \forall\; i \in \mathcal{I}$$

**Path connectivity — flow conservation:**
$$\sum_{(s,t)\in\mathcal{S}} z_{ist} = \sum_{(t,u)\in\mathcal{S}} z_{itu} \qquad \forall\; i,\; t$$

**Biomass yield via Gompertz coefficients:**
$$\sum_{j} X_{ijpt} \leq \sum_{(s,t)\in\mathcal{S}^{harv}} \eta_{p(t-s)} \cdot \text{AREA}_i \cdot z_{ist} \qquad \forall\; i,p,t$$

**Demand with quality cascade:**
$$\sum_{j,(p',p)\in\mathcal{Q}} X_{jkp'pt} \leq D^{max}_{kpt} \qquad \forall\; k,p,t$$

**Transport & inventory capacities/balances** — follows network flow structure `r Citep(bib, "DeMeyer2015_OPTIMASS")`

]

class: inverse, center, middle

# Case Study

---

## Study Region & Supply Chain Configuration

- **Region:** tri-state area of Saxony-Anhalt, northern Thuringia, northern Saxony (Germany)
- Highest density of registered SRC *Feldblöcke* in Germany
- **Supply chain structure:** AFS sites → storage/processing nodes → industrial consumers

.col-50[
**Sites $\mathcal{I}$**

- Registered SRC parcels from INVEKOS land-use register
- Clustered into representative site groups
- Site-specific area, establishment/harvest costs
]

.col-50[
**Consumers $\mathcal{K}$**

- 3 biomass product types: stems (P1), branches (P2), residues (P3)
- Industrial consumers: paper/pulp (Mercer), chemical biorefinery (UPM), wood industry, energy plants (biogas)
- Minimum demand threshold: $\geq$ 1.5 kt/year
]


---

## Case study data

.col-50[
```{r fig-supply-chain-network, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="85%", cache =TRUE}

crs_map <- 25833

# ── Colour palette constants (identical to fig-results-sc-map) ────────────────
COL_SAW <- "#e65c00"
COL_HUB <- "#c05000"
COL_P1  <- "#6a0dad"
COL_P2  <- "#08519c"
COL_P3  <- "#a50026"

# ── Map extent: defined in WGS84, transformed to projected CRS ───────────────
bbox_wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(
  st_bbox(c(xmin = 10.6, xmax = 13.2, ymin = 50.9, ymax = 52.8),
          crs = st_crs(4326))
)
bbox_map <- st_transform(bbox_wgs84, crs_map)
bbox_num <- st_bbox(bbox_map)

# ── Base-map layers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
de_states <- ne_states(country = "Germany", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_transform(crs_map) %>%
  st_intersection(bbox_map)

rivers_eu <- ne_download(
  scale    = 10,
  type     = "rivers_lake_centerlines",
  category = "physical",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map) %>%
  st_intersection(bbox_map)

# ── Cluster colour palette (no legend printed) ────────────────────────────────
cluster_assig <- afs_workspace$site_cluster_assig %>%
  select(site_id, hac_cluster) %>%
  mutate(hac_cluster = as.factor(hac_cluster))

n_clusters <- length(unique(cluster_assig$hac_cluster))

cluster_pal <- setNames(
  if (n_clusters <= 12) {
    colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(n_clusters, 12), "Set3"))(n_clusters)
  } else {
    scales::viridis_pal(option = "turbo")(n_clusters)
  },
  levels(cluster_assig$hac_cluster)
)

# ── Site polygons: join cluster assignment, project ───────────────────────────
sites_sf_clust <- sites_sf %>%
  mutate(site_id = seq_len(nrow(sites_sf))) %>%
  left_join(cluster_assig, by = "site_id") %>%
  st_transform(crs_map)

# ── Consumers & storages ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
consumers_plt <- consumers %>%
  mutate(
    total_demand = demand_P1 + demand_P2 + demand_P3,
    kategorie = case_when(
      demand_P1 >= demand_P2 & demand_P1 >= demand_P3 & demand_P1 > 0 ~ "Chemical / Pulp (P1)",
      demand_P2 >= demand_P1 & demand_P2 >= demand_P3 & demand_P2 > 0 ~ "Pulp / Paper (P2)",
      demand_P3 > 0                                                     ~ "Energy / Biogas (P3)",
      TRUE                                                              ~ "Other"
    ),
    pt_size = pmin(4.5, pmax(1.5, 1.5 + log1p(total_demand) * 0.55))
  )

storages_plt <- storages %>%
  mutate(
    #subtype = if_else(type == "Hub", "Logistics Hub", "Sawmill"),
    subtype = if_else(type == "Hub", "Hub", "Hub"),
    pt_size = 3.5
  )

stor_sf <- st_as_sf(storages_plt, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map)

cons_sf <- st_as_sf(consumers_plt, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map)

# ── Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gg <- ggplot() +

  # Base map
  geom_sf(data = de_states,
          fill = "grey96", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = rivers_eu,
          colour = "#4292c6", linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.7) +

  # KUP site polygons coloured by cluster — legend suppressed via guide = "none"
  geom_sf(data      = sites_sf_clust,

  # Pre-treatment facilities — new colour + shape scale after cluster fill

  geom_sf(data = stor_sf,

  # Consumer sites — fill scale registered after new_scale_fill() above
  geom_sf(data  = cons_sf,
          aes(fill = kategorie, size = pt_size),
          shape = 22, colour = "white", stroke = 0.45,
          alpha = 0.88, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Consumer type",
    values = c(

    )
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    xlim   = c(bbox_num["xmin"], bbox_num["xmax"]),

# Optimization Results

---

## Establishment decisions

.col-50[
```{r fig-results-sc-map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="85%", cache =TRUE}

crs_map <- 25833

# ── Colour palette constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
COL_SAW       <- "#e65c00"
COL_HUB       <- "#c05000"
COL_P1        <- "#6a0dad"
COL_P2        <- "#08519c"
COL_P3        <- "#a50026"
COL_SITE_ACT  <- "#1b9e77"
COL_SITE_NONE <- "#bdbdbd"

pal_products <- c(
  p1 = "#1b9e77",  # stem
  p2 = "#d95f02",  # branches
  p3 = "#7570b3"   # residues
)

# ── Map extent: define once in WGS84, transform to plotting CRS ──────────────
bbox_wgs84 <- st_as_sfc(
  st_bbox(c(xmin = 10.6, xmax = 13.2, ymin = 50.9, ymax = 52.8), crs = st_crs(4326))
)
bbox_map   <- st_transform(bbox_wgs84, crs_map)
bbox_num   <- st_bbox(bbox_map)

# ── Base-map layers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
de_states <- ne_states(country = "Germany", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_transform(crs_map) %>%
  st_intersection(bbox_map)

rivers_eu <- ne_download(
  scale = 10,
  type = "rivers_lake_centerlines",
  category = "physical",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map) %>%
  st_intersection(bbox_map)

# ── Aggregate harvest volumes per site over all periods ──────────────────────
site_harvest <- ext$Xij %>%
  group_by(site_id, product) %>%
  summarise(vol = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from   = product,
    values_from  = vol,
    values_fill  = 0,
    names_prefix = "p"
  )

for (col in c("p1", "p2", "p3")) {
  if (!col %in% names(site_harvest)) site_harvest[[col]] <- 0
}

site_harvest <- site_harvest %>%
  mutate(total_vol = p1 + p2 + p3) %>%
  filter(total_vol > 0)

active_site_ids <- unique(site_harvest$site_id)

# ── Site polygons for background activity map ────────────────────────────────
sites_sf_map <- sites_sf %>%
  mutate(site_id = seq_len(nrow(sites_sf))) %>%
  inner_join( afs_workspace$site_cluster_assig, "site_id" ) %>% 
  st_transform(crs_map) %>%
  mutate(
    active     = hac_cluster %in% active_site_ids,
    site_class = if_else(active, "Active site", "Inactive site")
  )

# ── Pie-chart data: use centroid coordinates in projected CRS ────────────────
sites_pie_sf <- milp_instance$sites %>%
  inner_join(site_harvest, by = "site_id") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map)

coords_sites <- st_coordinates(sites_pie_sf)

sites_pie <- sites_pie_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    x = coords_sites[, 1],
    y = coords_sites[, 2]
  )

vol_med <- median(sites_pie$total_vol[sites_pie$total_vol > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.na(vol_med) || vol_med <= 0) vol_med <- 1

# radius in map units (metres); tuned for this regional extent
sites_pie <- sites_pie %>%
  mutate(r = 3500 * sqrt(total_vol / vol_med))

# ── Consumers & storages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
consumers_plt <- consumers %>%
  mutate(
    total_demand = demand_P1 + demand_P2 + demand_P3,
    kategorie = case_when(
      demand_P1 >= demand_P2 & demand_P1 >= demand_P3 & demand_P1 > 0 ~ "Chemical / Pulp (P1)",
      demand_P2 >= demand_P1 & demand_P2 >= demand_P3 & demand_P2 > 0 ~ "Pulp / Paper (P2)",
      demand_P3 > 0 ~ "Energy / Biogas (P3)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    pt_size = pmin(4.5, pmax(1.5, 1.5 + log1p(total_demand) * 0.55))
  )

storages_plt <- storages %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = if_else(type == "Hub", "Logistics Hub", "Sawmill"),
    pt_size = pmin(3.5, pmax(1.2, 1.2 + log1p(CAP_proc) * 0.38))
  )

stor_sf <- st_as_sf(storages_plt, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map)

cons_sf <- st_as_sf(consumers_plt, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs_map)

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Base map
  geom_sf(data = de_states,
          fill = "grey96", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = rivers_eu,
          colour = "#4292c6", linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.7) +

  # Site polygons
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf_map,
          aes(fill = site_class),
          colour = NA, alpha = 0.55, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "AFS site status",
    values = c("Active site" = COL_SITE_ACT, "Inactive site" = COL_SITE_NONE)
  ) +

  # Pre-treatment facilities
  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
  ggnewscale::new_scale("shape") +
  geom_sf(data = stor_sf,
          aes(colour = subtype, shape = subtype, size = pt_size),
          stroke = 1.0, alpha = 0.92, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = "Pre-treatment",
    values = c("Sawmill" = COL_SAW, "Logistics Hub" = COL_HUB)
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Pre-treatment",
    values = c("Sawmill" = 16, "Logistics Hub" = 17)
  ) +

  # Consumer sites
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_sf(data = cons_sf,
          aes(fill = kategorie, size = pt_size),
          shape = 22, colour = "white", stroke = 0.45,
          alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Consumer type",
    values = c(
      "Chemical / Pulp (P1)" = COL_P1,
      "Pulp / Paper (P2)"    = COL_P2,
      "Energy / Biogas (P3)" = COL_P3,
      "Other"                = "grey60"
    )
  ) +

  # Pie charts at active sites
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  scatterpie::geom_scatterpie(
    data         = sites_pie,
    aes(x = x, y = y, r = r),
    cols         = c("p1", "p2", "p3"),
    colour       = "white",
    linewidth    = 0.15,
    donut_radius =.5,
    alpha        = 0.7,
    show.legend  = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Harvested biomass",
    values = pal_products,
    labels = c(p1 = "Stem", p2 = "Branches", p3 = "Residues")
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), guide = "none") +
  guides(
    fill   = guide_legend(order = 1),
    colour = guide_legend(order = 2,
                          override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 1.2)),
    shape  = guide_legend(order = 2,
                          override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 1.2))
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    xlim   = c(bbox_num["xmin"], bbox_num["xmax"]),
    ylim   = c(bbox_num["ymin"], bbox_num["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.25),

- **total profit:** `r round(result$objval/10^6,1)` Mill. €
- **opened super-farms:** `r length(unique(ext$z$site_id))`/`r milp_instance$n_sites`
- **biomass produced:** `r round(sum(ext$Xij$value)/1000,1)` Mill. t 
- **biomass consumed:** `r round(sum(ext$Xjk$value)/1000,1)` Mill. t 

```{r tab-biomass-balance, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# 1) Gesamt produzierte Biomasse nach Produkt (Xij)
prod_by_product <- ext$Xij %>%
  group_by(product) %>%
  summarise(
    produced_total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Gesamt konsumierte Biomasse nach Produkt (Xjk)
cons_by_product <- ext$Xjk %>%
  group_by(del_product) %>%
  rename(product = del_product) %>% 
  summarise(
    consumed_total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3) Zusammenführen und Bilanzspalte
biomass_balance <- prod_by_product %>%
  full_join(cons_by_product, by = "product") %>%
  mutate(
    produced_total = round(if_else(is.na(produced_total), 0, produced_total)/1000,1),
    consumed_total = round(if_else(is.na(consumed_total), 0, consumed_total)/1000,1),
    net_surplus    = round((produced_total - consumed_total),1)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    product = dplyr::case_when(
      product == 1 ~ "Stems",
      product == 2 ~ "Branches",
      product == 3 ~ "Residues",
      TRUE         ~ as.character(product)
    ))

# 4) Quarto/LaTeX/HTML-Tabelle
biomass_balance %>%
  arrange(product) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Total produced vs. consumed biomass by product.",
    col.names = c("Product", "Produced [Mill. t]", "Consumed [Mill. t]", "Surplus [Mill. t]"),
    digits = 1,
    format = knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to") %||% "html"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

## Product flows by type


```{r fig-results-harvest-gantt, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, out.width="90%", cache =TRUE}


# ── Labels & colours ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Source side (axis 1): biomass fractions delivered from sites → hubs (Xij)
#   product index 1 = Stems, 2 = Branches, 3 = Residues  [§2.2, f_p(t)]
SRC_LABEL <- c(
  "1" = "Stems",
  "2" = "Branches",
  "3" = "Residues"
)

# Delivery side (axis 2): consumer categories receiving from hubs (Xjk)
#   del_product 1 = Industrial (P1), 2 = Pulp & Paper (P2), 3 = Energy (P3)
DEL_LABEL <- c(
  "1" = "Industrial",
  "2" = "Pulp & Paper",
  "3" = "Energy"
)

# Fill colours for source strata — must match paper Fig. max3-growth
P_COLS_SRC <- c(
  "Stems"    = "#1b9e77",
  "Branches" = "#d95f02",
  "Residues" = "#7570b3"   
)

# ── Aggregate Xjk: src_product × del_product, summed over all periods/consumers
flow_df <- ext$Xjk %>%
  group_by(src_product, del_product) %>%
  summarise(volume = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(volume > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # axis1 = biomass fraction (source side)
    src = factor(SRC_LABEL[as.character(src_product)], levels = SRC_LABEL),
    # axis2 = consumer category (delivery/sink side)
    del = factor(DEL_LABEL[as.character(del_product)], levels = DEL_LABEL)
  )

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(flow_df,
       aes(axis1 = src, axis2 = del, y = volume, fill = src)) +

  geom_alluvium(
    alpha      = 0.72,
    width      = 1 / 3,
    knot.pos   = 0.45,
    curve_type = "sigmoid"
  ) +

  geom_stratum(
    width     = 1 / 3,
    fill      = "grey94",
    colour    = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  geom_text(
    stat       = "stratum",
    aes(label  = after_stat(stratum)),
    size       = 2.8,
    colour     = "grey15",
    lineheight = 0.88
  ) +

  # Axis header annotations — placed below the stratum columns
  # x = 1 (axis1 = Feedstock fraction), x = 2 (axis2 = End use)
  annotate("text",
    x        = c(1, 2),
    y        = -Inf,
    label    = c("Feedstock", "End use"),
    vjust    = 1.6,
    size     = 3.0,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour   = "grey30"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Biomass fraction",
    values = P_COLS_SRC          # only 3 source entries; no ghost colours
  ) +

  # ggalluvial uses integer axis positions (1, 2, …); do NOT set
  # limits = c("src", "del") — that breaks stratum positioning
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.25, 0.25))  # widen margins for stratum labels
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Volume (t dry matter)",
    labels = comma_format(big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +   # needed for below-axis annotations
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "none",
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.42, "cm"),
    plot.margin        = margin(t = 6, r = 6, b = 28, l = 6)
  )
```

## Rotation Age Distribution

```{r rotation-age-dist, fig.height=4.0, fig.width=8, out.width="90%", cache=TRUE}
# Illustrative distribution — ersetzen durch ext$z-Daten wenn Solver-Artefakte vorhanden
set.seed(42)
rot_ages <- tibble(
  rotation_age = sample(3:15,
    size    = 180,
    replace = TRUE,
    prob    = c(0.03, 0.07, 0.14, 0.18, 0.16, 0.13, 0.10,
                0.07, 0.05, 0.03, 0.02, 0.01, 0.01)
  )
)

ggplot(rot_ages, aes(x = rotation_age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#1b9e77", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(3, 15), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = 3.35, y = 36, label = expression(A[min]*"= 3"),
           size = 2.8, colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = 14.65, y = 36, label = expression(A[max]*"= 15"),
           size = 2.8, colour = "grey40", hjust = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 3:15) +
  labs(x = "Harvesting age (years)",
       y = "number of harvests") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

prod_labels <- c("1" = "Stem (P1)", "2" = "Branches (P2)", "3" = "Residues (P3)")

delivery_ts <- ext$Xjk %>%
  group_by(period, product = factor(del_product)) %>%

shipped_ts <- ext$Xij %>%
  group_by(period) %>%

  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.80, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +

            aes(x = period, y = shipped),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            colour = "#636363", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +

  scale_x_continuous(name = "Planning period (year)",

# Conclusion

---

## Open Research Questions

.callout-important[
**Planned computational experiments**
- **Allometric parameter uncertainty:** sensitivity of optimal rotation length to Gompertz parameter ranges
- **Price scenarios:** impact of biomass price trajectories (P1/P2/P3) on product mix and supply chain configuration
- **Policy incentives:** effect of AFS subsidies and carbon pricing on establishment decisions
- **Scalability:** solution quality and computation time for larger site/consumer instances
]

--

**Further directions:**
- Stochastic programming extensions for yield and demand uncertainty
- Multi-objective optimization (economic vs. ecological performance)
- Integration of ecosystem service valuations (carbon sequestration, biodiversity)

## Sets, Indices & Parameters

.col-50[
**Sets & indices**

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $\mathcal{I}$ | AFS sites (field parcels) |
| $\mathcal{J}$ | Storage/processing facilities |
| $\mathcal{K}$ | Industrial consumers |
| $\mathcal{P}$ | Biomass product types |
| $\mathcal{Q}$ | Quality cascade pairs $(p', p)$ |
| $\mathcal{T}$ | Planning periods |
| $\mathcal{S}$ | Feasible activity arcs $(s, t)$ |
]

.col-50[
**Key parameters**

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $\eta_{p,a}$ | Yield (t/ha) for product $p$ at age $a$ |
| $\text{AREA}_i$ | Site area (ha) |
| $c^{est}_i$ | Establishment cost (€/ha) |
| $c^{harv}_i$ | Harvest cost (€/ha) |
| $c^{opp}_i$ | Opportunity cost (€/ha/yr) |
| $R_{kp}$ | Revenue (€/t) at consumer $k$ |
| $d_{ij}, d_{jk}$ | Transport distances (km) |
]

---

## Decision Variables

| Variable | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| $z_{ist} \in \{0,1\}$ | Binary | Activity arc: site $i$ from period $s$ to $t$ |
| $X_{ijpt} \geq 0$ | Continuous | Biomass flow: site $i$ → storage $j$, product $p$, period $t$ |
| $X_{jkp'pt} \geq 0$ | Continuous | Processed flow: storage $j$ → consumer $k$, cascade $(p',p)$ |
| $S_{jpt} \geq 0$ | Continuous | Inventory at storage $j$, product $p$, end of period $t$ |

.callout-note[
**Age-lag structure:** Arc $(s,t) \in \mathcal{S}^{harv}$ is only feasible if $A_{min} \leq t-s \leq A_{max}$,
enforcing rotation age bounds without additional constraints.
]
